function: Learns BS beamforming vectors and RIS phase shifts (PPO actor, continuous actions) to maximize average video PSNR, with application-layer rate-distortion parameters in the state (p. 4).
system: Downlink MISO: BS with M=8 or 12 antennas, K=8 or 12 single-antenna devices, passive RIS with N=8 or 12 elements, narrowband Rayleigh fading, 50 kHz bandwidth (pp. 2, 6).
method: PPO (actor-critic, on-policy), both networks fully connected with four hidden layers, GAE, clipped objective; reinforcement learning; extension feeds the RIS-optimized channel to DROO offloading (pp. 4-5, 11).
data_channel: Simulated random Rayleigh fading, entries CN(0,1) (Table 1, p. 6); BS-RIS and RIS-WD composite treated as one effective channel (p. 2); no 3GPP model, dataset, or measurement.
test_conditions: Same simulated environment for training and evaluation: average PSNR versus time step, one curve per (K,M,N) setting (8,8,8), (8,8,12), (12,12,8), (12,12,12); no unseen conditions (pp. 5-7).
baselines: Learned: RIS-SAC [13] (p. 5); DROO-based MEC without RIS [17] and with cross-layer video control [43] (pp. 10-12). No non-learned method.
metrics: Average PSNR (dB) versus time step; total network parameters; sum computation rate in bits/s for the MEC extension (pp. 6-7, 12-13).
complexity: Total network parameters: RIS-PPO 2,389,081 versus RIS-SAC 21,284,146 (K=8,M=8,N=12); 3,161,337 versus 23,082,610 (K=12,M=12,N=12); 86-89% fewer (p. 6, Table 3).
q1_support: p. 2: "following the Rayleigh fading distribution"; Table 1 (p. 6) lists Rayleigh CN(0,1) initialization. This is a custom Rayleigh simulation; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 12: "The number of RIS elements is varied across" three settings (4, 8, 12), each shown as its own training curve (Figs. 11-13); the paper never states that a trained model is tested under a configuration not used for its training.
q3_support: p. 5: "adopts the SAC algorithm, while the proposed scheme" (RIS-SAC [13], learned); p. 10: "which adopts the Deep Reinforcement learning-based Online" (DROO, learned baseline of the MEC extension). No non-learned method such as random or fixed RIS phases or an optimization algorithm is compared.
q4_support: p. 6: "TABLE 3. Complexity analysis of the total network parameters." (2,389,081 versus 21,284,146 parameters for K=8, M=8, N=12).
q5_support: p. 12: "each WD and the AP is modeled as a random Rayleigh" fading channel; the channels are simulated, no public dataset or measurement is used, and no link to code or data appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: PDF title and DOI match (p. 1). Tables 1-3 (p. 6) and Tables 4-6 (p. 12) were read from the page images. Included because PPO learns the physical-layer RIS phase and beamforming jointly with application-layer video parameters; the MEC offloading extension (DROO, pp. 10-11) is above the physical layer, but PPO still learns the RIS phase there. Table 3 gives parameter counts for only two configurations. No carrier frequency is stated.
